description: No clean concept found. The unit fires on about 3% of positions, somewhat more often in the opening (roughly the first 8-12 stones), but which positions fire depends on the exact stone layout in a way that follows no recognizable Connect Four pattern (threats, center control, last move, edges). Its best simple proxy, 'early game', is weak (F1 0.10).
effect: None measurable: forcing it to its max or to zero changes move probabilities by at most 0.02 on 6 positions.
notes: Tried: early game (F1 0.104, AUROC 0.59), their last stone beside my previous stone (F1 0.044, chance), early + my bottom corner (F1 0.076). Single-feature histograms showed no signal. Activation is board-determined but minimal-pair column effects flip sign between bases. Likely a random direction or a highly distributed feature. Synthesis best 2.79 < dev max 3.08.
